column3: “Servant” is rendered “bond-servant”; “in the Dispersion” is rendered “who are dispersed abroad.”
“Brothers” is rendered “brethren,” and “fall into” “encounter.”
Close to the Greek.
“Its perfect work” is rendered “its perfect result.”
“Not finding fault” is rendered “without reproach”; NASB supplies “men.”
“Wave” is rendered “surf.”
“Suppose” is rendered “expect.”
NASB adds “being.”
“Boast” is rendered “glory,” “of low degree” “of humble circumstances,” and “exaltation” “high position.”
NASB supplies “let … glory”; “a flower of grass” is rendered “flowering grass.”
“Burning heat” is rendered “scorching wind”; the Greek aorists are rendered as present.
“Endures” is rendered “perseveres under.” NASB has “the Lord,” which matches the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “He.”
NASB adds “when he is”; “evils” is rendered “evil.”
“Desire” is rendered “lust”; NASB supplies “each one” and “when.”
“Desire” is rendered “lust,” and “fully grown” “accomplished.”
“Misled” is rendered “deceived,” and “brothers” “brethren.”
“Act of giving” is rendered “thing bestowed.”
“Having willed” is rendered “In the exercise of His will”; NASB adds “as it were.”
NASB follows the critical text (“This you know”); “swift” is rendered “quick.”
“Works” is rendered “achieve.”
“Excess of wickedness” is rendered “all that remains of wickedness.”
“Be” is rendered “prove yourselves,” and “only” “merely.”
“Has been likened to” is rendered “is like.”
NASB adds “once”; “what like” is rendered “what kind of person.”
“Freedom” is rendered “liberty,” and “a doer of the work” “an effectual doer”; NASB supplies “the law.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “among you”; “seems” is rendered “thinks himself.”
NASB adds “our” before “God and Father.”
